scope: Synthetic public extension packages on isolated Linux source builds; no installed/private-corpus claim

protocol.filesystemCache: not evicted; generated inputs written before timing
protocol.classification: Faster/Slower requires all five pairs in that direction and nonoverlapping before/after ranges; otherwise No clear change
protocol.loaderClock: immediately before loadExtensions to its resolved return, after harness imports/setup
protocol.rpcClock: immediately before spawn to matching successful get_commands after successful get_state; includes synchronous streamed-receipt retention, decoding and inline readiness checks
